newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji Heavy likely to raise 1996/97 dividend--paper.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Heavy likely to raise 1996/97 dividend--paper.

text.p: Fuji Heavy Industries Ltd is likely to increase its dividend for the 1996/97 business year to six to seven yen per share from five yen in the previous year, a Japanese business daily reported on Friday. The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said that the company is likely to raise its dividend because its parent current profit for the current business year is expected to triple from a year earlier to around 30 billion yen.
The yen's retreat against the dollar is also expected to boost the company's profits by about four billion yen in 1996/97, the paper said.
A company spokesman was not immediately available to comment on the report.
